Cranberry Gin Cocktail
By: Lauren Short
Published: Saturday, December 24, 2016 - 8:08am

Ingredients




1 measure Gin (2 if you like)
150 ml Cranberry Juice
10 ml Lemon Juice
Ice Cubes
Fresh Cranberries
Mint Leaves

Preparation

1 Fill a tumbler glass with ice cubes and add the gin and lemon juice. Top with the cranberry juice and stir. Taste and adjust the quantities how you'd like. 2 Garnish with a few cranberries and mint leaves.

About

A simple and zesty Cranberry Juice and Gin Cocktail
